name: 雾门滩
Fog Gate Strand
before: 后千里出港第七天，海上立起一堵白墙，从天顶垂到水面，左右望不到头。阿汐把潮信簿翻到最后一页，再往后，她爹一个字也没写。船在雾边一片荒滩下了锚，滩上插着一块新漆的木牌：「雾海禁地，挂灯之船，截。」牌下一队雾海水兵正把篝火踩灭，望见后千里桅上的三百盏灯笼，齐齐拔出了刀。

On the seventh day out of port a white wall stands up from the sea, hanging from the sky to the water, no end to it either way. Axi turns her tide book to its last page; beyond it her father wrote nothing. The ship anchors off a bare strand at the fog's edge, where a freshly painted board reads: 'Sea of Fog. Forbidden. Any ship showing lights will be stopped.' Beneath it a squad of Fog Sea marines are stamping out their fire. They see the three hundred lanterns on Houqianli's masts and draw their blades as one.
after: 水兵退进雾里，丢下一本值哨簿。阿汐摸了摸海水：「水冰，风暖。」暖湿的南风吹过冷海，水汽一凉就凝成雾；冷水不走，雾不散。值哨簿头一页写着：「丁未年八月，奉令截千里号。」此后十年，每天一行：「未见。」

The marines fall back into the fog and leave a watch log behind. Axi dips a hand in the sea. 'The water bites, but the wind is warm.' Warm, wet southerlies blowing over a cold sea: the moisture chills and turns to fog, and while the cold water stays, so does the fog. The log's first page reads: 'Eighth month of the Dingwei year. Ordered to stop the Qianli.' Every day for ten years after, one line: 'Not sighted.'

name: 射萤坡
Firefly Butts
before: 坡上草丛里飞着萤火虫，一闪一闪。一队雾海弩手趴在坡顶，见光就射，十年练下来，箭箭穿萤。坡下的村子夜里不敢点灯，做饭全凭摸，孩子们把萤火虫装进瓶子当灯，被弩手连瓶子一起射碎。村口贴着告示：「雾岸一线，片光不许，违者以通敌论。」

Fireflies blink in the grass on the slope. A squad of Fog Sea crossbowmen lies along the crest and shoots at any light, and ten years of practice have taught them to hit a firefly with every bolt. The village below dares not light a lamp; supper is cooked by touch. The children keep fireflies in bottles for lamps, and the crossbowmen shoot the bottles too. A notice at the village gate: 'Along the Fog Coast, no light of any kind. Offenders will be treated as traitors.'
after: 弩手们跑了，孩子们又把萤火虫装进瓶子。村里老人说，十年前八月起，提督下令雾岸灭灯：渔火、窗灯、坟头的长明灯，一盏不留。最后灭的是北岬上戚家的望雾灯，「照了雾海一百年，说灭就灭了」。

The crossbowmen run, and the children fill their bottles again. From the eighth month ten years ago, the old people say, the admiral ordered the Fog Coast dark: fishing lights, window lamps, the undying lamps on graves, every one. The last to go out was the Qi family's Fogwatch Light on the north cape. 'It lit the Sea of Fog for a hundred years, and then it was just gone.'

name: 挂铃村
Bell Village
before: 雾岸不许点灯，夜里雾又浓，人走路常撞个满怀，雾海水兵便立了规矩：天黑出门，腰上挂铃。如今全村叮叮当当，牛挂铃，狗挂铃，连水兵自己也挂。铃是水兵卖的，一只三十文。这几天他们挨家搜一个「不挂铃的丫头」，说她夜里偷东西，走路一点声都没有。

No lights are allowed on the Fog Coast and the nights are thick, so people kept walking into each other; the Fog Sea marines made a rule that anyone out after dark wears a bell. Now the whole village jingles. Cows wear bells, dogs wear bells, the marines wear bells. The marines sell them, thirty coppers each. For days they have been searching house to house for 'the girl with no bell', who steals at night and makes no sound at all.
after: 村里人把铃解下来，扔了一箩筐。他们说那丫头叫戚小满，北岬守灯人戚守光的孙女，偷的都是怪东西：一块铜皮、一截灯芯、半罐鱼油。「她爷爷十年前点了一回灯，被抓走了。她想把那盏灯再点起来。」

The villagers unhook their bells and throw them in a basket. The girl, they say, is Qi Xiaoman, granddaughter of Qi Shouguang, the keeper of the north cape light, and she steals odd things: a sheet of copper, a length of wick, half a jar of fish oil. 'Her grandpa lit his lamp once, ten years ago, and they took him away. She wants to light it again.'

name: 倒船屋
Upturned Hulls
before: 滩头高地上一排怪屋子，全是破船倒扣过来搭的，船底朝天当屋顶，有一间的船名倒写在门楣上。住的是一伙「吃礁的」，专等夜里船撞了礁，划过去捞货。灭灯十年，他们吃得满面红光，还雇了一伙雾海跳帮手看家，见有人提灯过路，就扑上去把灯打翻。

On the high ground above the strand stands a row of strange houses, each one a wrecked boat turned keel-up for a roof; on one lintel the ship's name reads upside down. They belong to wreckers who wait for ships to strike the reefs at night and row out for the cargo. Ten dark years have fattened them, and they have hired Fog Sea boarders to guard the place, who pounce on anyone passing with a lantern and knock it from his hand.
after: 跳帮手们败了，吃礁的头子缩在船屋里不敢出来。他说这十年什么都捞过，就是没捞着千里号：「那一夜我们在礁上蹲了一整宿，北岬的灯偏偏亮了一刻钟。就一刻钟，那几条船全绕过去了。」他到今天还记恨戚老头。

The boarders are beaten and the wreckers' chief hides in his hull. In ten years, he says, they've salvaged everything except the Qianli. 'We crouched on the reef all that night, and the north cape light came on for a quarter of an hour. Just a quarter of an hour, and every one of those ships went round.' He still holds it against old Qi.

name: 网雾坡
Fog-Net Hill
before: 坡上竖着一排排竹竿，竿间张着细网，网上挂满了水珠，一滴滴流进底下的陶缸。网雾翁靠这些网接雾水过日子，雾岸打不出好井，他这几十口缸是十里内唯一的清水。一伙雾海跳帮手扛着空桶上了坡，说舰队缺水，要把缸一口口抬走，抬不动的就砸。

Rows of bamboo poles stand on the hill with fine nets strung between them, beaded with droplets that run down into clay jars. The old fog-netter lives on what the nets catch; no good well can be dug on the Fog Coast, and his jars hold the only clean water for ten li. A gang of Fog Sea boarders climbs up with empty buckets: the fleet is short of water, they say, and the jars are coming with them, and the ones too heavy to carry get smashed.
after: 跳帮手们提着空桶跑了。网雾翁说坡顶望得见北岬：十年前那一夜雾薄了些，他看见北岬的灯三明一暗，打了三遍；雾里亮起三盏船灯，并排挂着，答了一遍，就往东去了。「活了七十年，头一回见灯跟灯说话。」

The boarders run off with empty buckets. From the hilltop, the old man says, you can see the north cape. That night ten years ago the fog was thinner, and he saw the cape light flash three bright and one dark, three times over. Out in the fog three ship's lamps lit up side by side, answered once, and went east. 'Seventy years I've lived, and that was the first time I saw lights talk to each other.'

name: 灭灯营
Lights-Out Camp
before: 荒原上一座大营，营门口堆着小山似的灯：渔灯、风灯、宫灯、孔明灯、坟前的长明灯，全是十年里收来的。营里雾海水兵、弩手、跳帮手样样齐全，专管雾岸灭灯。可营官怕黑，夜夜在帐里点一盏小油灯，拿黑布罩着，只漏一线光，生怕被自己的兵瞧见。

A big camp on the moor, with a hill of lamps heaped at its gate: fishing lamps, storm lanterns, palace lanterns, sky lanterns, the undying lamps from graves, ten years of confiscations. Marines, crossbowmen and boarders, the camp has them all, and its one job is keeping the coast dark. But the commandant is afraid of the dark. Every night he lights a little oil lamp in his tent under a black cloth that lets out a single thread of light, terrified his own men will notice.
after: 营官抱着他那盏小灯投降了，红着脸说：「我也是人。」收灯簿翻到十年前八月：「北岬戚守光，私点望雾灯一刻，拘押雾岸营狱。灯镜一面、灯罩一具，没官。」一刻钟的灯，换了十年的牢。

The commandant surrenders hugging his little lamp, red-faced: 'I'm only human.' The confiscation book, at the eighth month ten years ago: 'Qi Shouguang of the north cape lit the Fogwatch Light without leave, one quarter hour. Held in the Fog Coast fort gaol. One lamp mirror, one lamp chimney, seized.' A quarter hour of light, ten years in a cell.

name: 吐气泽
Belching Marsh
before: 一片黑泥沼泽，一脚踩下去咕嘟冒泡，臭鸡蛋味熏得人睁不开眼，岸上人管它叫「鬼吐气」，谁也不敢进。一队雾海水兵在泽边烧芦苇，要把躲在里头的人熏出来。烟里传出一个丫头的声音，又尖又脆：「烧吧！芦苇烧光了，我也不出来！」

A marsh of black mud that bubbles under every step, with a rotten-egg stink that makes your eyes stream; the shore folk call it 'the ghost's breath' and no one goes in. A squad of Fog Sea marines is burning the reeds at its edge to smoke someone out. From the smoke comes a girl's voice, sharp and clear: 'Burn away! Burn every reed, I'm still not coming out!'
after: 水兵撤了，一个瘦丫头从芦苇里钻出来，满腿黑泥，腰上没铃：戚小满。她说这里不闹鬼：烂草烂叶埋在泥底不透气，闷久了就放出这股臭气，熏人，不吃人，正好藏东西。她从泥里拽出一只油布包，包着北岬灯塔的铜钥匙。

The marines withdraw, and a skinny girl climbs out of the reeds, black mud to the knees and no bell at her waist: Qi Xiaoman. There's no ghost here, she says. Dead reeds and leaves buried in the mud get no air, and rotting shut away like that they give off this stink. It chokes you, it doesn't eat you, and it's perfect for hiding things. She hauls an oilcloth bundle out of the mud. Inside is a copper key: the door of the north cape lighthouse.

name: 百衲被
The Patchwork Quilt
before: 荒原上一座孤零零的老屋，屋前晾着一床百衲被，红黄蓝白的布块拼成一圈一圈的花样。一队雾海水兵正把被子从竹竿上扯下来，说是查抄的「通敌之物」。屋里的老太太拄着拐追出门，一边追一边骂：「十年了，你们连一床被子都不放过！」

A lone old house on the moor, a patchwork quilt airing out front, red, yellow, blue and white squares pieced into rings. A squad of Fog Sea marines is dragging it off the pole as 'goods aiding the enemy'. An old woman comes after them on her stick, scolding all the way: 'Ten years, and you won't even leave me a quilt!'
after: 被子抢回来了。老太太是戚守光的老伴戚婆。小满一看就叫起来：被面上的花样是灯语，奶奶十年里一针针缝的。三块红布一块黑：「三明一暗，平安，往东。」被角一行小字：「三灯并挂，谢灯，后会。」那是千里号的回话。

The quilt is won back. The old woman is Granny Qi, the keeper's wife. Xiaoman cries out at the sight of it: the pattern is lamp-talk, and her grandmother stitched it square by square for ten years. Three red patches and one black: 'Three bright, one dark. Safe passage, go east.' In one corner, a line of tiny stitches: 'Three lamps abreast. Thanks for the light. Until we meet.' That was the Qianli's answer.

name: 卖光屋
The Light Shop
before: 岔路口有一间没窗的土屋，门口挂块牌子：「卖光，一炷香十文。」屋里点着一支蜡烛，进去的人或缝衣，或读信，或者只是看看老伴的脸。屋主是个精明的灯油贩，雇了一伙雾海跳帮手守门，交不起钱的一脚踹出来。屋外排着长队，个个在黑地里攥着铜钱。

At a fork in the road stands a windowless mud hut with a sign: 'Light for sale. Ten coppers a joss stick.' Inside burns a single candle, and those who go in mend clothes, or read letters, or just look at their old husband's or wife's face. The owner is a shrewd lamp-oil dealer who has hired Fog Sea boarders for the door, and anyone short of coin gets kicked back out. A long queue waits in the dark, every hand clutching coppers.
after: 跳帮手被打跑，屋主只好把蜡烛免费点到天亮。一个老汉借着光读完了儿子三年前的信，哭得像个孩子。旧账上记着十年前：「八月廿六，戚守光，赊鲸油十斤，未还。」那一夜的灯，是赊来的油点的。小满替爷爷还了账。

With the boarders gone, the owner has to burn his candle free till dawn. One old man finally reads his son's letter from three years ago and weeps like a boy. In the old ledger, ten years back: 'Twenty-sixth of the eighth month. Qi Shouguang, ten jin of whale oil on credit. Unpaid.' That night's light burned on borrowed oil. Xiaoman settles her grandfather's debt.

name: 白纱会
The White Veil Society
before: 一群披白纱的人在荒原上排成长队，绕着一块大石头转圈，嘴里念着「雾娘娘，莫揭面」。他们说雾是娘娘的面纱，灯光刺破面纱，娘娘就要发怒翻船。领头的香主骑一头驴，身边护着一队雾海跳帮手，谁家漏出一点光，就拿湿泥把窗户糊上。

A line of people draped in white veils circles a great stone on the moor, chanting, 'Lady of the Fog, keep your face hidden.' The fog, they say, is the Lady's veil; a light pierces it, and in her anger she overturns ships. Their leader rides a donkey with a guard of Fog Sea boarders, and wherever a crack of light shows, they plaster the window over with wet mud.
after: 跳帮手跑了，香主的驴也跑了。香主是个退伍的水兵，老实交代：这个会是灭灯营出钱办的，「让人拜娘娘，比拿刀守着省事」。供桌下压着一张旧画，画的是北岬灯塔，灯被涂成了黑的，旁边写：「娘娘之敌，戚。」

The boarders run, and so does the donkey. The leader turns out to be a retired marine, and he owns up: the Lights-Out Camp pays for the society. 'Getting people to worship the Lady is cheaper than guarding them with swords.' Under the altar lies an old painting of the north cape lighthouse with its lamp painted black and a note beside it: 'Enemy of the Lady: Qi.'

name: 白鹭洲
Egret Isle
before: 沼泽中间一片芦苇洲，白鹭成千上万，飞起来像下了一场雪。一伙雾海弩手蹲在洲边射鹭鸟，拔背上的长羽卖去做帽缨。看鹭的小哑巴拿石子砸他们，砸一颗，挨一箭，箭箭擦着耳朵过去：弩手们拿他取乐。

In the middle of the marsh lies a reed island where egrets roost by the thousand; when they rise it looks like snow. Fog Sea crossbowmen squat at its edge shooting the birds and plucking their long back plumes to sell for hat tassels. The mute boy who minds the egrets pelts them with pebbles, and for every pebble he gets a bolt that just grazes his ear: the crossbowmen are having fun with him.
after: 弩手被赶出沼泽，鹭鸟又落了回来。小哑巴在泥上画给你们看：一个老头，一个少年，坐在灯塔下，老头指着鹭鸟飞走的方向。戚婆说，那是守光年轻时收的徒弟，渔家小子，跟他学了三年看雾，后来去投了水师。「姓岑。」

The crossbowmen are driven out of the marsh and the egrets settle again. The mute boy draws in the mud for you: an old man and a youth under a lighthouse, the old man pointing where the egrets fly. Granny Qi says that was Shouguang's apprentice when he was younger, a fisher boy who learned fog-reading from him for three years and then joined the navy. 'His name was Cen.'

name: 岑家老屋
The Cen House
before: 荒原尽头一座石屋，门前种着两棵歪脖子松。屋里住着个瞎了一只眼的老太太，每年这一天都要在窗台上点一盏灯，给儿子过生日。守屋的却是她儿子派来的雾海跳帮手，个个低着头，挡在窗前不让点：「老夫人，军令如山，提督也是没法子。」

At the far end of the moor stands a stone house with two crooked pines at the door. Inside lives an old woman blind in one eye, who every year on this day wants to light a lamp on the sill for her son's birthday. The men guarding the house were sent by that son, Fog Sea boarders who keep their heads down and block the window: 'Madam, orders are orders. The admiral can't help it either.'
after: 跳帮手退到了院外。岑老太摸着火石把灯点上：她儿子就是雾海提督岑定波。抓戚守光那夜，他回家在黑屋里坐到天亮，只说了一句：「师父点灯，我灭灯，各尽各的本分。」此后十年，他没再回过家。

The boarders back out into the yard. Old Mrs Cen finds the flint and lights her lamp. Her son is Cen Dingbo, Admiral of the Sea of Fog. The night he arrested Qi Shouguang he came home and sat in the dark house till dawn, and said only one thing: 'My master lights the lamp, I put it out. Each of us does his duty.' In the ten years since, he has never come home.

name: 空帆风车
Bare Windmills
before: 荒原上一排风车，本是盐户车海水上滩晒盐用的。风车的帆布全被雾海水兵扯走了，说舰队的帆破了没处补。如今只剩光秃秃的木架，盐户们只好爬上去拿手转，一圈一圈，转得头晕眼花，盐滩还是半干不湿。水兵又来了，这回要拆木架当柴烧。

A row of windmills on the moor once pumped seawater up onto the salt pans. The Fog Sea marines tore away every sail, saying the fleet's canvas is in rags and there's nothing to patch it with. Now only bare frames remain, and the salt workers climb up and turn them by hand, round and round until they're dizzy, and the pans still won't dry. Today the marines are back to pull down the frames for firewood.
after: 水兵被赶走，木架保住了，阿樯从后千里上拆下两面旧帆送了过来。盐户说他们每月往雾岸营狱送一回盐，狱里的伙夫每回都多要半碗：「有个老犯人，天天拿盐水洗眼睛，说眼睛不能坏，出去还要看灯。」戚守光还活着。

The marines are driven off and the frames saved, and Aqiang brings two old sails over from Houqianli. Once a month, the salt workers say, they deliver salt to the fort gaol, and the cook always asks for an extra half bowl. 'There's an old prisoner who bathes his eyes in salt water every day. Says his eyes mustn't fail, he still has a lamp to watch when he gets out.' Qi Shouguang is alive.

name: 结绳铺
The Knot Shop
before: 路边一间卖麻袋的小铺，掌柜是个结绳的老手，渔网、缆绳、盐袋口，什么结都会打。一伙雾海水兵把铺子翻了个底朝天，一只只拆盐袋的袋口绳，说营狱里有人拿绳结往外递消息。拆下来的绳头堆了一地，掌柜心疼得直咂嘴：「这都是好结啊。」

A little sack shop by the road, kept by an old knotter who can tie anything: nets, hawsers, the necks of salt bags. Fog Sea marines have turned the shop upside down and are unpicking the cord on every salt sack, saying someone in the fort gaol is passing messages out in knots. Cord ends pile up on the floor and the shopkeeper clicks his tongue in grief: 'Those were good knots.'
after: 水兵走了。掌柜从柜底摸出一把旧绳头，十年里从营狱退回来的空盐袋上解下的，每根都打着同样的结：三个紧，一个松。小满攥着绳头，眼泪一下子下来了：三明一暗，爷爷每个月都在说，「我好，灯还在」。

The marines leave. From under the counter the shopkeeper brings out a handful of old cord ends, untied over ten years from the empty salt sacks returned by the gaol. Every one carries the same knots: three tight, one loose. Xiaoman clutches them and the tears come at once. Three bright, one dark. Every month her grandfather has been saying, 'I'm well. The light still stands.'

name: 传令驿道
The Dispatch Road
before: 荒原上一条笔直的土路，每隔五里一座烟墩，是舰队和岸营之间递令的驿道。雾里看不见烟，他们就敲鼓，咚咚咚一路传过去。驿道上驻着一大队雾海水兵、弩手、跳帮手，路边立着牌子：「军令往来，闲人回避。」今天的鼓敲得特别急。

A ruler-straight dirt road across the moor, with a signal mound every five li: the dispatch road between the fleet and the shore forts. Smoke can't be seen in the fog, so they beat drums instead, boom boom boom, passed from mound to mound. A large force of marines, crossbowmen and boarders holds the road under a sign: 'Military dispatches. Civilians keep clear.' Today the drums are beating fast.
after: 驿卒们散了，鼓也停了。驿匣里压着灭灯令的抄本，末尾有提督亲笔添的两行：「戚守光不许杀，不许放。」底下又一行墨迹新些：「若有船挂千字灯来，速报。」今天急鼓报的，正是后千里。

The couriers scatter and the drums fall silent. In the dispatch box lies a copy of the lights-out order, with two lines added at the end in the admiral's own hand: 'Qi Shouguang is not to be killed. Nor released.' Below, in fresher ink: 'If a ship comes showing Qian lanterns, report at once.' Today's urgent drums were about Houqianli.

name: 泥马滩
Mud-Sled Flats
before: 沼泽外缘的滩涂上，滩民一条腿跪在一块翘头木板上，一条腿在泥上蹬，嗖嗖地滑，这东西叫「泥马」，泥里跑得比人快十倍。一伙雾海跳帮手抢了泥马，在滩上赛着玩，把滩民挖了一早上的蛏子全压成了泥饼。

On the mudflats at the marsh's edge, the flat-folk kneel on one leg on a board with an upturned nose and kick off the mud with the other, skimming along. They call it a mud-horse, and on the flats it's ten times faster than walking. A gang of Fog Sea boarders has stolen the mud-horses to race each other, and flattened the morning's whole catch of razor clams into mud cakes.
after: 跳帮手被掀翻在泥里，泥马还给了滩民。滩上的老人说，从这里滑过去，退潮时能一直滑到雾岸营的后墙底下，那里的墙脚泡在泥里，是营里最松的一段。小满记下了：她要的不光是灯，还有爷爷。

The boarders are tipped into the mud and the mud-horses go back to their owners. From here, an old flat-man says, at low tide you can slide all the way to the back wall of the Fog Coast fort, where the foot of the wall sits in mud and is the weakest stretch of the whole fort. Xiaoman makes a note of it. It isn't only the lamp she wants. She wants her grandfather.

name: 泥炭村
Peat Village
before: 荒原上的人不烧柴，烧泥炭：从沼地里切出一块块黑砖，晒干了能烧一冬。一队雾海跳帮手占了村子，把晒好的泥炭垛全封了，说舰上的伙房要用，村里人只能拿湿炭烧，屋里烟比雾还浓，家家咳嗽。

Nobody on the moor burns wood; they burn peat, black bricks cut from the bog and dried to last a winter. A squad of Fog Sea boarders has taken the village and sealed every dried stack for the fleet's galleys, so the villagers must burn wet peat, and the smoke indoors is thicker than the fog. Every house is coughing.
after: 炭垛解了封，屋里总算不呛人了。村长领你们去看一样东西：村后有一垛谁也不许动的干炭，每年添一层，十年添成了小山。「戚老头点灯从前烧鲸油，鲸油没了就烧这个。哪天北岬要点灯，炭是现成的。」

The stacks are unsealed and the houses can breathe again. The headman takes you to see something: behind the village stands a stack of dry peat nobody may touch, a new layer added each year until it's a little hill. 'Old Qi burned whale oil in his lamp, and when that ran short he burned this. The day the north cape lights again, the fuel's ready.'
first: 垛里抄出跳帮手囤的三百块干泥炭、两袋炒豆、一桶咸鳗，还有一只从村里抢来的铜手炉，炉里的炭还没凉。
In the stacks you find the boarders' hoard: three hundred dry peat bricks, two sacks of roasted beans, a keg of salted eel, and a brass hand-warmer taken from the village, its coals still warm.
pass: 每次路过，村里人都往你们车上码几块干泥炭，再塞一兜炭火里煨熟的芋头，说「雾里冷，揣着走」。
Every time you pass, the villagers stack dry peat on your carts and press on you a bag of taro baked in the embers. 'It's cold in the fog. Keep these in your coat.'

name: 雾钟寺
Fog Bell Temple
before: 荒原边一座小寺，寺里一口大铜钟，从前起雾就敲，一刻一响，海上的船听着钟声认岸。灭灯令下来，雾海水兵连钟也禁了，把钟锤摘走，拿铁链锁住钟口。老和尚每天起雾就去摸摸钟，嘴里「当」一声，算是敲过了。今天水兵又来，要把钟抬走熔了铸箭头。

A small temple on the moor's edge with a great bronze bell. It used to ring once every quarter hour whenever the fog came in, and ships at sea found the shore by its sound. When the lights-out order came the marines banned the bell too, took away its striker and chained its mouth shut. Every foggy day the old monk goes and pats the bell and says 'dong' aloud, and counts that as ringing it. Today the marines are back to haul the bell off and melt it down for bolt heads.
after: 水兵被赶出了山门，钟保住了。老和尚说那一夜他和戚守光约好了：「他点灯，我敲钟。灯一刻，钟十五响。」打完第十五下，营里的兵就冲上了北岬。钟锤被收走那天，守光在囚车里冲他喊：「和尚，替我记着，是十五下！」

The marines are driven out of the gate and the bell is saved. That night, the old monk says, he and Qi Shouguang had an agreement. 'He lit the lamp and I rang the bell. A quarter hour of light, fifteen strokes.' At the fifteenth, the fort's men stormed the north cape. On the day they took the striker away, Shouguang shouted to him from the prison cart: 'Monk, remember for me! It was fifteen!'

name: 问爹卡
The Ask-Father Toll
before: 路口横着一根木杆，杆后站着一排孩子，最大的不过十二岁，过路的人要交「消息钱」：说一件舰队上的事，才许过去。孩子们的爹都在雾海水师当兵，十年没回过家。几个上了年纪、留守岸上的雾海水兵被孩子们支使着看杆子，一脸无奈。

A pole blocks the crossroads, and behind it stands a row of children, the eldest no more than twelve. Travellers must pay a news toll: tell one thing about the fleet and you may pass. Every child's father serves in the Fog Sea navy, and none has been home in ten years. A few elderly marines on shore duty have been bossed into minding the pole, looking helpless.
after: 老兵们被打得心服口服，杆子抬了起来。你们说了舰队缺水缺帆的事，孩子们一声不吭。一个老兵叹气：「令不撤，船就不回港。」他刚从营狱换班出来，说那个姓戚的老犯人每夜拿手指在墙上画灯，画了十年，墙都画亮了。

The old marines are beaten fair and square and the pole goes up. You tell the children what you know: the fleet is short of water and sailcloth. They listen without a sound. 'While the order stands, the ships don't come home,' one old marine sighs. He has just come off a shift at the fort gaol, and says the old prisoner named Qi draws a lamp on the wall with his finger every night. Ten years of it, and the wall has gone shiny.

name: 守明村
Shouming Hamlet
before: 雾里有座小村，村口两个雾海水兵拄着枪说：「这村十年前就绝户了，进去做什么？」可村里有一扇窗透出火光。开门的白发老人见了你们很高兴，熬了一锅鱼片粥，说难得来客，又问北岬的灯点没点。粥很香，炉火很暖。他起身去添柴，你们这才看见他背后的墙上供着一块灵牌，写着他自己的名字：戚守明，卒于十年前八月廿六。

There is a little village in the fog, and two marines leaning on their spears at its gate say, 'Everyone in there died out ten years ago. What do you want with it?' But firelight shows at one window. A white-haired old man opens the door, delighted to see you, and cooks a pot of fish porridge; visitors are rare, he says, and asks whether the north cape light is lit yet. The porridge is good, the fire is warm. When he gets up to add wood you see, on the wall behind him, a spirit tablet bearing his own name: Qi Shouming, died on the twenty-sixth of the eighth month, ten years ago.
after: 门外的水兵闯进来要抓「死人」，被你们打了出去。老人笑出了眼泪：他是守光的亲弟弟，那夜替哥哥扛油上灯塔。哥哥被抓后，全村人给他报了丧，立了牌位，官府就不来抓死人了。「我这个死人，活得比谁都踏实。」

The marines burst in to arrest the dead man and you throw them out. The old man laughs until he cries. He is Shouguang's younger brother, and that night he carried the oil up the lighthouse. After his brother was taken, the whole village reported him dead and put up a tablet, and the officials don't come for dead men. 'For a corpse, I sleep better than anyone.'

name: 高脚哨
Stilt Watchtower
before: 沼泽里竖着一座高脚木哨楼，四根长柱插在泥里，楼顶正对着北岬。一伙雾海弩手日夜守在上面，盯着那座黑了十年的灯塔，哪怕塔顶闪一下，就要放响箭报营。弩手们闲得发慌，在栏杆上刻了密密麻麻的「正」字，一个字五天。

A watchtower on four tall stilts stands in the marsh, its top facing the north cape. Fog Sea crossbowmen keep watch up there day and night on the lighthouse that's been dark ten years, ready to loose a whistling arrow to warn the fort if the top so much as flickers. Bored stiff, they've carved the railing full of tally marks, five days to a mark.
after: 弩手们顺着柱子溜下去跑了。哨簿上十年都是「北岬无光」，只有每年八月廿六那天多一行：「提督独乘小艇至北岬，登塔，一刻，下。」他每年都去，在那座不许点的灯下面，站一刻钟。

The crossbowmen slide down the stilts and run. For ten years the watch log says only 'North cape, no light', except on the twenty-sixth of the eighth month each year, which has one more line: 'The admiral came alone by skiff to the north cape, climbed the tower, one quarter hour, came down.' Every year he goes and stands a quarter hour beneath the lamp no one may light.

name: 镜锅灶
The Mirror Wok
before: 荒原上一座雾海弩手的伙房，灶上架着一口奇大的「锅」，铜胎锃亮，锅底一圈圈磨得极圆，炒菜时火光一照，整个伙房金灿灿的。伙夫把它当宝，说是从营里库房换来的，炒什么都香。小满一看就跳了起来：「那是我家的灯镜！」

A Fog Sea crossbowmen's cookhouse on the moor, where an enormous 'wok' sits over the stove: polished bronze, its bowl ground into perfect rings, so that when the fire catches it the whole cookhouse glows gold. The cook treasures it; he swapped it out of the fort stores, he says, and everything tastes better from it. Xiaoman jumps at the sight: 'That's our lamp mirror!'
after: 弩手们被赶跑，小满抱着那口「锅」不撒手。灯镜是铜磨的，把一盏灯的光拢成一束，打出几十里去。镜面被铲出几道印子，还沾着十年的油烟。伙夫心疼地递来一包细灰：「拿草木灰擦，擦得回来。」

The crossbowmen are chased off and Xiaoman won't let go of the 'wok'. The mirror is ground bronze; it gathers one lamp's light into a beam that reaches dozens of li. Its face is scored where the spatula scraped and coated with ten years of cooking grease. The cook, grieving, hands over a packet of fine ash. 'Scrub it with wood ash. It'll come back.'

name: 捣衣溪
Washing Creek
before: 营狱背后一条小溪，洗衣妇们蹲在石头上捣衣，替营里洗号衣，也替狱里洗囚衣。一伙雾海跳帮手守在溪边，每件囚衣都要抖开验过，说怕里头夹带东西。领头的洗衣妇是个大嗓门的胖婶，捣衣杵抡得比刀还响，一边捣一边骂：「验吧验吧，验出个虱子赏你！」

Behind the fort gaol runs a little creek where washerwomen squat on the rocks pounding laundry: the garrison's uniforms, and the prisoners' smocks. A gang of Fog Sea boarders stands guard and shakes out every smock for smuggled goods. The head washerwoman is a stout, loud auntie whose paddle rings louder than a sword, cursing as she pounds: 'Go on, check it! Find a louse and I'll give you a prize!'
after: 跳帮手被赶走，胖婶从洗衣篮最底下抽出一件旧囚衣：衣襟上用香头烫了三个小洞，留一处空着，十年里她洗过的每一件都这样。「我认不得字，可我认得这老头。」她说他托她带过一句话：「小满别来，看灯。」

The boarders are driven off, and the auntie pulls an old smock from the bottom of her basket: three little holes burned in the front with an incense tip and one space left bare, like every smock she has washed for ten years. 'I can't read, but I know that old man.' Once, she says, he gave her a message to pass on: 'Xiaoman, don't come. Mind the lamp.'

name: 狱卒酒寮
Turnkeys' Tavern
before: 营狱外一间矮酒寮，下了值的狱卒都来这里喝两盅。今天被一伙雾海跳帮手包了场，他们是提督派来加岗的，嫌狱卒看得松，正拍着桌子训人。几个老狱卒缩在墙角，端着酒不敢喝，有一个小声嘀咕：「看了十年，那老头一回也没想跑过。」

A low tavern outside the fort gaol where off-duty turnkeys come for a cup. Today a gang of Fog Sea boarders has taken the whole place; the admiral sent them to double the guard, and they think the turnkeys are slack, and they're pounding the table lecturing them. A few old turnkeys huddle in a corner holding cups they don't dare drink. One mutters, 'Ten years, and the old man's never once tried to run.'
after: 跳帮手们被扔出了门，老狱卒们这才喝上酒。他们说提督每年都派人问戚老头一句：「从此不点灯，就放你回家。」十年，老头答的都是同一句：「放我回去，我就点。」所以门一直锁着，饭倒从没少过一顿。

The boarders are thrown out and the old turnkeys finally drink. Every year, they say, the admiral sends someone to put one question to old Qi: 'Promise never to light the lamp again and you can go home.' And for ten years the old man has given the same answer: 'Let me go and I'll light it.' So the door stays locked, though he has never missed a meal.

name: 转鼓墩
Relay Drum Mound
before: 荒原东头一座烟墩，是岸营往舰队传令的最后一站，墩上架着一面牛皮大鼓。一伙雾海弩手守着墩子，鼓手每天敲三通平安鼓，舰队那边雾里也回三通。今天鼓手刚举起槌，要敲的是另一种点子：急、急、缓，急、急、缓。

A signal mound at the moor's eastern end, the last relay from the shore forts to the fleet, with a great oxhide drum on top. Fog Sea crossbowmen hold the mound. Each day the drummer beats three rolls for all-is-well, and out in the fog the fleet beats three back. Today the drummer has just raised his sticks for a different rhythm: fast, fast, slow; fast, fast, slow.
after: 鼓槌被夺下，那通鼓没敲出去。弩手的传令簿上，这一通写的是：「后千里登岸，挂千字灯，疑即千里号。」上一页是舰队传来的：「镇雾号粮尽，请岸营速送米。淡水岛的水，今年也少了。」雾里的舰队，日子不比岸上好过。

You wrest the sticks away and the message never goes out. In the crossbowmen's dispatch book it reads: 'Houqianli has landed, showing Qian lanterns. Suspected to be the Qianli.' On the page before, a message from the fleet: 'Zhenwu out of grain. Send rice from shore at once. The Freshwater Isle spring runs low this year too.' Out in the fog the fleet is living no better than the coast.

name: 封油窖
The Sealed Oil Cellar
before: 北岬脚下的荒坡上有个半埋的地窖，是戚家存灯油的地方，窖门上的封条已经烂成了纸灰。一队雾海跳帮手占了地窖，撬开一坛闻了闻，说是好油，要整坛整坛运去舰上点伙房。戚守明拄着拐追来，指着他们骂：「那是灯油！点灯的！不是炒菜的！」

On the slope below the north cape lies a half-buried cellar where the Qi family kept their lamp oil; the seal on its door has rotted to paper ash. A squad of Fog Sea boarders has occupied it, pried open one crock and sniffed it, and declared it good oil, fit to ship to the fleet for the galleys. Qi Shouming comes after them on his stick, shouting, 'That's lamp oil! For the lamp! Not for frying!'
after: 跳帮手被赶走，油坛一只没碎。坛口封着厚厚的蜂蜡，鲸油不见风，十年也没坏。守明拍着坛子说，哥哥当年最后一回下窖，在墙上划了一道：「留三坛，等我。」剩下的正好三坛。泥炭村的干炭垛也扛来了，就等上塔。

The boarders are driven off and not one crock is broken. Each is sealed with thick beeswax, and whale oil kept from the air has not spoiled in ten years. Shouming pats the crocks. The last time his brother came down here, he scratched a line on the wall: 'Leave three crocks. Wait for me.' Exactly three are left. The dry peat from Peat Village has been carried up too. All that remains is the climb.

name: 雾岸营狱
Fog Coast Gaol
before: 雾岸营狱的高墙泡在泥滩里，墙头插满了箭楼，墙里关着十年来违了灭灯令的人。提督加派的雾海水兵、弩手、跳帮手里外三层，前门密不透风。可退潮了，泥马滩的滩民推着十几架泥马，悄悄滑到了后墙脚下：那一段墙根泡软了，一推就晃。

The high walls of the Fog Coast gaol stand in the mudflats, bristling with arrow towers; inside are ten years of people who broke the lights-out order. The marines, crossbowmen and boarders the admiral sent are three ranks deep and the front gate is sealed tight. But the tide is out, and the flat-folk of Mud-Sled Flats have pushed a dozen mud-horses quietly up to the back wall, where the soaked foot of it wobbles at a shove.
after: 后墙塌了一段，守兵溃散。最里头的牢房墙上画满了灯，被手指磨得发亮。戚守光瘦得只剩骨头，眼睛却清亮，看见小满提着的灯笼，眯了半天：「十年没见过光了，倒还认得。」他第一句问的是：「灯镜擦了没有？」

A stretch of the back wall collapses and the garrison breaks. The walls of the innermost cell are covered in drawn lamps, rubbed shiny by fingers. Qi Shouguang is skin and bone, but his eyes are clear. He squints a long while at the lantern in Xiaoman's hand. 'Ten years without seeing a light, and I still know one.' His first question: 'Have you scrubbed the mirror?'

name: 报讯码头
The Dispatch Jetty
before: 营狱一破，几个雾海跳帮手冲到营后的小码头，跳上一条快艇，要去雾里给舰队报信：犯人跑了，后千里到了。他们手忙脚乱解缆绳，越急越解不开。戚守光拄着小满的肩走过来，看着他们，反倒摆了摆手。

The moment the gaol falls, a few Fog Sea boarders race to the little jetty behind it and leap into a fast boat to carry word into the fog: the prisoner is out, Houqianli has come. They fumble at the mooring line, and the more they hurry the less it comes loose. Qi Shouguang walks over leaning on Xiaoman's shoulder, watches them, and, to everyone's surprise, waves a hand.
after: 跳帮手们被打下了艇，守光却让把他们放了：「去告诉岑定波，我回北岬点灯了。」他对你们说，那夜千里号拿灯问他一句：「何处有水？」他答：「淡水岛，往东。」后来是船主沈渡亲手打的灯语，「灯打得比我还稳」。

The boarders are knocked off their boat, but Shouguang has them let go. 'Go and tell Cen Dingbo I've gone home to light the lamp.' That night, he tells you, the Qianli asked him by lamp, 'Where is water?' and he answered, 'Freshwater Isle, go east.' The ship's owner Shen Du signalled with her own hands. 'Steadier than mine, her lamp.'

name: 望雾灯
The Fogwatch Light
before: 北岬尖上一座石砌的灯塔，黑了十年，塔门锈死，石阶上长满了青苔。塔下扎着灭灯营最后一支人马，雾海水兵、弩手、跳帮手，奉的是提督的死令：「北岬一灯不许点。」他们也知道营狱破了、犯人来了，排成三列，枪尖都对着那条上塔的小路。

On the tip of the north cape stands a stone lighthouse, dark for ten years, its door rusted shut and its steps green with moss. At its foot waits the last company of the Lights-Out Camp, marines, crossbowmen and boarders, under the admiral's standing order: 'Not one lamp on the north cape.' They know the gaol has fallen and the prisoner is coming. They stand three ranks deep, every spearpoint aimed at the path up to the tower.
after: 守兵散了。小满拿铜钥匙捅开塔门，守光一级级爬上去，守明扛着油坛，泥炭村的人扛着干炭。灯镜擦亮了，装回原位，鲸油点着，一道光直直刺进雾里，三明一暗，打了三遍。雾里很久没有动静。然后，极远的东南方，亮起三盏灯，并排挂着。守光扶着栏杆，半天才说：「是那小子。他还记得。」

The garrison scatters. Xiaoman opens the tower door with the copper key and Shouguang climbs step by step, Shouming carrying the oil, the Peat Village folk carrying dry peat. The scrubbed mirror goes back in its place, the whale oil catches, and a beam drives straight into the fog: three bright, one dark, three times over. For a long while nothing stirs. Then, far off to the south-east, three lamps light up side by side. Shouguang grips the rail and at last says, 'That's the boy. He remembers.'
